tools.name: calculate_race_fuel_and_weight
tools.description: Plan a race fuel load, reserve, start weight, and projected minimum-weight margin. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Assumes the entered per-lap consumption applies to race, formation, and allowance laps. Finish weight retains only the sel

tools.name: calculate_gear_ratio_speed
tools.description: Check speed, RPM, and shift drop from tire size, final drive, and gear ratio. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Use measured tire diameter when possible. Tire growth and converter/clutch slip can move real-world numbers.

tools.name: calculate_tire_pressure_adjustment
tools.description: Turn cold, hot, and target hot pressures into the next cold pressure to try. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This gives a next-test pressure, not a universal ideal. Recheck after the next run.

tools.name: calculate_corner_balance
tools.description: Calculate cross weight, left/right balance, and front/rear split from four scale pads. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Measure the car in the same state you drive it: driver, fuel, ballast, and tire pressures matter.

tools.name: calculate_spring_wheel_rate
tools.description: Convert spring rate and motion ratio into wheel rate for setup comparisons. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Wheel rate compares spring changes. It does not account for bars, bump stops, tires, or aero load.

tools.name: calculate_fuel_injector_size
tools.description: Estimate injector size from horsepower, fuel type, injector count, and duty cycle. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This is a sizing estimate. Confirm with your tuner and fuel pressure data.

tools.name: convert_afr_lambda
tools.description: Convert AFR and lambda across gasoline, E85, methanol, and race fuel scales. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Use this as a conversion reference. Tune targets depend on fuel, engine, load, and calibration strategy.

tools.name: calculate_brake_bias
tools.description: Estimate front brake bias from piston area, rotor size, and pad friction. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This estimates mechanical bias. Tire grip, weight transfer, ABS, and balance bars still matter.

tools.name: compare_tire_sizes
tools.description: Compare tire diameter, circumference, ride height, and speedometer change. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Actual mounted diameter changes by tire model and pressure. Use manufacturer specs when available.

tools.name: check_race_alignment
tools.description: Check camber and total toe against broad autocross and track baseline ranges. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This is a baseline checker, not a vehicle-specific prescription. Tire wear and driver feedback decide the next step.

tools.name: calculate_lap_time_delta
tools.description: Compare two laps or sector sets and see the best theoretical lap. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Use sectors from timing, video, or data logs. Compare similar conditions before blaming setup.

tools.name: calculate_ethanol_blend
tools.description: Calculates an ethanol blend for a fresh tank, existing fuel, correction, or ratio without authentication or account-data access. tools.name: analyze_tire_temperatures

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_ai_log_tuner_transcripts, get_ai_log_tuner_transcript, list_ai_race_engineer_transcripts, get_ai_race_engineer_transcript · Private data: delete_vehicle_modification, complete_maintenance, list_ecu_files, inspect_ecu_file, process_ecu_file, retry_ecu_file, delete_ecu_file · Public sink: get_tuneworks_app_capabilities, get_share_build_options, preview_share_build, process_ecu_file, retry_ecu_file, send_share_build, send_team_invite · Destructive: calculate_gear_ratio_speed, calculate_tire_pressure_adjustment, delete_vehicle_modification, archive_vehicle, copy_shop_list, reset_shop_list_items, delete_shop_list, delete_vehicle_make, delete_chart_channel_set, delete_favorite_chart, delete_ecu_file, remove_team_member, leave_team, delete_team, delete_custom_track, delete_object_attachment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_ai_log_tuner_transcripts, get_ai_log_tuner_transcript, list_ai_race_engineer_transcripts, get_ai_race_engineer_transcript · Private data: delete_vehicle_modification, complete_maintenance, list_ecu_files, inspect_ecu_file, process_ecu_file, retry_ecu_file, delete_ecu_file · Public sink: get_tuneworks_app_capabilities, get_share_build_options, preview_share_build, process_ecu_file, retry_ecu_file, send_share_build, send_team_invite · Destructive: calculate_gear_ratio_speed, calculate_tire_pressure_adjustment, delete_vehicle_modification, archive_vehicle, copy_shop_list, reset_shop_list_items, delete_shop_list, delete_vehicle_make, delete_chart_channel_set, delete_favorite_chart, delete_ecu_file, remove_team_member, leave_team, delete_team, delete_custom_track, delete_object_attachment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
